name: Matron
persona: The headman of the village: speaks for the Tree of Pain, and always has work for strong hands.

greet: In the name of the Tree of Pain — a new face!
quest: We need {need}. Bring it and {village} owes you.
Find {need} out there on the map and come back to me.
thanks: You are a friend of {village} now. {reward}

say: {village} is a village of the Dark Elves. Elegant, cruel and clever; the Dark Elves smile at every guest and count the cost of each smile.
